record.oneLiner: Docs-and-tables platform (now Superhuman Docs) with a REST API using bearer API tokens, plus an official Coda MCP endpoint.
record.verdictReason: UNVERIFIED IN PART: the API page confirms bearer-token auth and broad read/write of rows and pages, but no fetched page states how to obtain a token or confirms the free tier, so accessLevel is unverified. The MCP evidence quote could not be fetched (help pages returned HTTP 403), so existingMcp rests on a search result only. The coda.io URL redirected to docs.superhuman.com, which is treated as the vendor's documentation.

evidence.quote: a RESTful API that lets you programmatically interact with data in Superhuman Docs (formerly Coda):
Read, insert, upsert, update, and delete rows
